raw_html: [[Spell Resonance]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Spell Resonance]]:''' This item hums ominously with suppressed energy. When casting Force spells, there is a chance that you will gain a +20 [[alchemical bonus]] to Force [[Spell Power]] for 30 seconds. When casting Sonic spells, there is a chance that you will gain a +20 alchemical bonus to Sonic [[Spell Power]] 30 seconds.
